en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Al-Suweyq builds the flesh and strengthens the bones’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Bakr ibn Muhammad who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
sawiq grows flesh and strengthens the bones .’”
